DM as SOVD Server The DM shall act as SOVD Server as specified by ASAM SOVD[5] according to the configuration referenced by SovdModuleInstantiation.communicationConnector.
DNS-Based Service Discovery and Multicast DNS for SOVD The DM shall support DNS-SD (DNS-Based Service Discovery) and mDNS (Multicast DNS) as specified by ASAM SOVD[5].
Secure Communication for SOVD using TLS The DM shall secure its HTTP connections using TLS according to the configuration referenced by SovdModuleInstantiation.securePropsForTcp.

Representation of DM by SOVD component The DM shall be represented by an SOVD component that shall be a child of the SOVD Server in the role components. The corresponding component-identifier shall be derived from the SovdServerInstantiation.

Representation of Diagnostic Server instance by SOVD subcomponents Each Diagnostic Server instance shall be represented by one corresponding SOVD component that shall be a child of the SOVD component representing the DM in the role subcomponent. The corresponding component-identifier shall be derived from the SoftwareClusterSovdAddress.
Dispatching of SOVD requests/responses Within the DM SOVD requests and responses shall be dispatched to and from the Diagnostic Server instances based on the SOVD path.
Behavior on locked SOVD If a service cannot be performed or a session change is not possible due to SOVD lock, NRC 0x21 (BusyRepeatRequest) shall be returned.

Response behavior of SOVD services without access rights If the request is an SOVD request and the service execution verification fails due to a failed check in scope of [SWS_DM_01223], the Diagnostic Server instance shall send a HTTP response status code 401 (Unauthorized) and error_code set to insufficient-access-rights and stop the service processing.

SOVD mode dtcsetting set value The SOVD method Explicit Control of Entity States via Their Defined Modes of SOVD mode dtcsetting with valid value in the request body shall be processed analog to Service Service ControlDTCSetting (0x85) of ISO 14229- 1[1].

SOVD mode dtcsetting get value The SOVD attribute value in the response body of SOVD method Get Details of a Single Mode of an Entity of SOVD mode dtcsetting shall return the current state of the Diagnostic Server instance according to Service ControlDTCSetting (0x85) of ISO 14229-1[1].

SOVD mode dtcsetting value schema The SOVD attribute value of SOVD mode dtcsetting shall be a JSON enum with possible values off and on. These value shall be mapped to the subfunction parameter of Service ControlDTCSetting (0x85) of ISO 14229-1[1].
SOVD mode dtcsetting name The SOVD attribute name of the SOVD mode dtcsetting shall be a constant string with value dtcsetting.

SOVD mode dtcsetting If a DiagnosticControlDTCSetting is configured, the Diagnostic Server instance shall offer a SOVD mode dtcsetting with SOVD methods Get Details of a Single Mode of an Entity and Explicit Control of Entity States via Their Defined Modes according to ASAM SOVD[5].

SOVD mode commctrl set value The SOVD method Explicit Control of Entity States via Their Defined Modes of SOVD mode commctrl with valid value in the request body shall be processed analog to Service CommunicationControl (0x28) of ISO 14229-1[1] using the same instance of the processing mechanism.

SOVD mode commctrl get value The SOVD attribute value in the response body of SOVD method Get Details of a Single Mode of an Entity of SOVD mode commctrl shall return the current state of the Diagnostic Server instance according to Service CommunicationControl (0x28) of ISO 14229-1[1].

SOVD mode commctrl value schema The SOVD attribute value of SOVD mode commctrl shall be a JSON enum. For each DiagnosticComControl one possible enum value shall be derived from the category of the corresponding DiagnosticComControl.
SOVD mode commctrl name The SOVD attribute name of the SOVD mode commctrl shall be a constant string with value commctrl.

SOVD mode commctrl If at least one DiagnosticComControl is configured, the Diagnostic Server instance shall offer a SOVD mode commctrl with SOVD methods Get Details of a Single Mode of an Entity and Explicit Control of Entity States via Their Defined Modes according to ASAM SOVD[5].

SOVD method Retrieve List of All Supported Modes of an Entity If at least one SOVD mode is configured the Diagnostic Server instance shall provide the SOVD method Retrieve List of All Supported Modes of an Entity according to ASAM SOVD[5].

SOVD method Terminate execution of an Operation – proximity_response The proximity_response in the request body of SOVD method Terminate the Execution of an Operation shall be validated using ara::diag::SovdProximityChallenge::ValidateResponse.

Support of SOVD method Terminate execution of an Operation For each DiagnosticSovdOperationStop, the Diagnostic Server instance shall provide the SOVD method Terminate execution of an Operation according to ASAM SOVD[5][14].

Support of SOVD method Read the Status of an Operation Execution For each DiagnosticSovdOperationGetStatus, the Diagnostic Server instance shall provide the SOVD method Read the Status of an Operation Execution according to ASAM SOVD[5][14].

Support of SOVD method Query for executions of an operation For each SOVD operation supporting asynchronous_execution, the Diagnostic Server instance shall support the SOVD method Query for executions of an operation according to ASAM SOVD[5][14].

Support of SOVD method Start Execution of an Operation For each DiagnosticSovdOperationStart, the Diagnostic Server instance shall provide the SOVD method Start Execution of an Operation according to ASAM SOVD[5][14].
SOVD operation mode The SOVD attribute modes of a SOVD operation shall not be supported.

SOVD operation attribute asynchronous_execution If the DiagnosticSovdOperationPrimitive only aggregates a DiagnosticSovdOperationStart (DiagnosticSovdOperation.start), the attribute asynchronous_execution of the corresponding SOVD operation shall be FALSE, else the attribute shall be TRUE.

SOVD operation attribute proximity_proof_required The SOVD attribute proximity_proof_required of a SOVD operation shall derived from the proximityProofRequired of the corresponding DiagnosticSovdOperation.
SOVD operation attribute name The SOVD attribute name of a SOVD operation shall be derived from the longName of the corresponding DiagnosticSovdOperation.
SOVD operation attribute id The SOVD attribute id of a SOVD operation shall be derived from the shortName of the corresponding DiagnosticSovdOperation.
